svg.title: The metric coefficient satisfies M(0) = I. Subtract the same expression with M = I. Its discrepancy is the product of two first-order exterior differences and the first-order metric discrepancy, hence vanishes to order three. The free exterior identity says that the expression with M = I is the lattice scalar times the identity. Combining with the preceding ghost calculation proves the vector third- order cancellation. This uses the actual quadratic symbol normalization, including its longitudinal gauge-fixing term. The one-field ghost vertex has the exact component expression h −e−i(ka+pa)qa(k) + qa(−k −p)eikai (Tb)xy.
